run_two_level_clustering: run two-level hierarchical k-means clustering on a training set with configurable cluster counts per level
train_ivf_index_with_2level: train a Faiss IVF index using two-level clustering to produce balanced inverted file centroids
run_balanced_assignment_with_penalties: assign vectors to centroids with a balance constraint using iterative penalty adjustments
run_kmeans: run a pure Python k-means clustering implementation that accepts a DatasetAssign wrapper for training data
run_reassign_centroids: reassign collapsed empty centroids by splitting occupied centroids and redistributing their assignments
